body.message:
Good morning, Shawin.

Thank you for your message and for sharing your concern.

As mentioned previously, it is very rare for such a situation to occur. In the unlikely event that the apartment is sold or becomes unavailable, we will inform you at least one month in advance and do our best to find a suitable solution.

However, we are unable to guarantee at this stage that a replacement apartment will be available in City Walk, Downtown, or the surrounding areas . Availability depends on the inventory at that time, and therefore we cannot include such a guarantee in the contract.

Please rest assured that we will make every effort to accommodate your preference and assist you in finding the best possible alternative should the need arise.

Kindly let us know your decision at your earliest convenience, as we are unable to hold the apartment any longer. We have already reserved the unit for you since yesterday at no additional cost, and we appreciate your understanding.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your patience and understanding.
